status: Proposed (2026-10-07) by openspec/changes/light-baking, design sections 11, 12 and 15: the mockup baker's final settings. Read by docs/mockups/lighting.html and docs/mockups/deck-plan.html today, by sc-tools bake once it is built.
_rules: Every key has a unit or is a count; a present zero means zero. An unknown key is an error. tools/lighting_check.py validates this file.

reference_lux: the irradiance that shows a surface at exactly its texture colour. ambient_scale_lux: ShipKit.LIGHTING's ambient colour times its weight times this is each state's ambient fill in lux, times the baked occlusion.

shadow_samples per lamp per receiver; emitter samples one per emitter_sample_area_m2 and at least one per emitter_sample_spacing_m of its longest edge; ao_rays and ao_radius_m the occlusion; bounces 0, 1 or 2, read from an irradiance cache of cache_spacing_m with cache_gather_rays per point and cache_filter_passes of a tent filter; gather_rays where bounce is gathered per sample (probes); ray_bias_m along the normal; sample_inset_m inside a face's edge; dither on the 8-bit output.

adaptive and max_added_triangles: the engine's subdivision (design section 3), and the lighting page's. mockup: the deck plan's stand-in for it (design section 15), cells no wider than cell_m on floors, walls and ceilings; uncapped_triangles the lighting page's no-cap comparison.
gather_range_m: how far a bounce ray looks for the surface whose light it reads (80 m holds any compartment of a ship; a station's bay is 540 m across).

station: a spacedock bay's bake (openspec/changes/spacedock design 8a): the bay's wall, its ribs and its berths cut to cells no wider than wall_cell_m, rib_cell_m and berth_cell_m; a face under cheap_area_m2 casts shadows but neither sends nor gathers bounce; a part's reflectance is its tint times albedo_scale (the bake does not read the texture's mean).
presets override these: preview for a quicker bake, station for a bay hundreds of metres across (wide emitter samples, a 20 m occlusion radius, a 16 m cache, bounce read across the bay).
